name: Kuke Music Holding Limited
summary: Kuke Music Holding Limited, established in Beijing, China, in 2002, specializes in delivering a variety of classical music-related services across the Chinese market. Its core offerings encompass music licensing, subscription plans, and educational programs. The company's operations are divided into two main areas. The first, designated as its Subscription, Licensing, and Smart Education sector, handles the distribution of commercial music rights and develops advanced music education solutions. The second segment, focusing on Music Events, Performances, and Ancillary Services, orchestrates music festivals and live performances, offers publicity and promotional support, provides technical assistance, and sells musical instruments, including its signature "conch smart speakers." Kuke's extensive music library is licensed to a wide range of clients. These include leading online music streaming services like Tencent Music Entertainment Group and NetEase Cloud Music, other digital music providers, various business organizations, film and television production studios, airlines, and manufacturers of smart hardware. Its institutional customer base features academic establishments such as universities and music conservatories, public library systems, and governmental bodies spanning numerous autonomous regions and municipalities.
